message.reasoning:
We need to generate a test class for NumericIndicator.max(Indicator<Num>) method. Use JUnit5, Mockito. Need to set up dependencies: a NumericIndicator instance (wrap a delegate indicator). Use existing test patterns: they use MockBarSeries etc. For max method, we need to test both static (Number) and dynamic (Indicator) variant? The focal method is max(Indicator<Num>) returning NumericIndicator via BinaryOperation.max(this, other). We need to test that result indicator returns max of values.

We can create a simple indicator using ConstantIndicator or ClosePriceIndicator. Use MockBarSeries with known values. Use NumericIndicator.of(cp1) as base, and another indicator (e.g., EMAIndicator) or ConstantIndicator. Then call max(other) and assert values.

We need to set up fields in @BeforeEach: series, closePriceIndicator, emaIndicator, numericIndicator.

Also need to mock BinaryOperation? Not needed; we can just test behavior.

Import necessary classes: BarSeries, MockBarSeries, ClosePriceIndicator, EMAIndicator, NumericIndicator, Indicator, Num, etc.

Use assertNumEquals from TestUtils? In template they didn't import. Could use assertEquals with Num? Better to use assertNumEquals static method from org.ta4j.core.TestUtils. Add import.

Write two test methods: maxWithNumber (via max(Number) maybe but focal is Indicator version; but we can test both). But requirement is for max(Indicator<Num>) only. So test dynamic max.

Implementation: NumericIndicator result = numericIndicator.max(ema); For each index, expected = cp1.getValue(i).max(ema.getValue(i)). Use Num.max? In Num interface there is max method? Might be .max(Num). Use cp1.getValue(i).max(ema.getValue(i)). Then assertNumEquals.

Also test that delegate of result is instance of BinaryOperation? Not accessible. So just test values.

Setup: use function numFunction from AbstractIndicatorTest? Not available. In this test we can use MockBarSeries default uses default num function maybe. Use new MockBarSeries(num -> ???). In other tests they have a constructor with Function<Number, Num>. Here we don't have that. Simpler: use BarSeries series = new MockBarSeries(); but need to supply numFunction. Looking at Ta4j's MockBarSeries constructor: there is a constructor with Function<Number, Num> and values. To avoid complexity, we can mock Indicator<Num> directly using Mockito.

Alternative: Use Mockito to mock Indicator<Num> returning predetermined Num values. Then we can test max logic without real series.

Create mock Indicator<Num> a = mock(Indicator.class); when a.getValue(0) returns numOf(1); etc. Need a way to get Num instances: use org.ta4j.core.num.DecimalNum? Could use numFunction from test utils? Simpler: use org.ta4j.core.num.DecimalNum.valueOf(double). Import DecimalNum.

So we can create two mock indicators with values: a returns 1,2,3; b returns 2,1,4; then max should be 2,2,4.

Set up mock behavior with when(a.getValue(anyInt())).thenAnswer(i->...). Use thenAnswer.

Implement test method.

Also test that result is instance of NumericIndicator.
